title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We're excited to announce the general availability of Spyglass, empowering you with a robust and enhanced tool for improved insights and productivity.

title: Seamless Media Management
summary: We've introduced intuitive new controls within the editor, empowering you to effortlessly upload, organize, and customize how your files and images appear in your work.

title: Explore Our Interactive Product Roadmap
summary: Discover our latest accomplishments, exciting upcoming features, and future plans all in one transparent and easy-to-navigate public roadmap.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've upgraded our checkboxes for effortless task management, featuring bigger clickable areas, drag-and-drop functionality, and a modern design.

title: Enhanced Team Collaboration
summary: Our enhanced collaboration features now provide a smoother, more intuitive experience, making teamwork more efficient and enjoyable for everyone.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Shared Items
summary: We've made it simpler than ever to share your ideas and collaborate with friends, ensuring all relevant shared items are easily discoverable and accessible.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out robust support for international languages worldwide.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: We are open-sourcing Noeko's codebase to empower users with maximum control, direct involvement in its evolution, and complete transparency.

title: Unlock Deeper Insights with Advanced Knowledge Map Filters
summary: Effortlessly explore and organize your entire knowledge base by applying powerful new filters for tags, time, and shared items to your visual overview, transforming it into an indispensable workflow starter.

title: Refine Your Knowledge with Powerful Search
summary: Elevate your search experience with new filtering and sorting tools, enabling you to pinpoint information and save your unique queries as personalized collections for future access.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: This feature empowers you to effortlessly organize and interact with your linked ideas, tasks, and sources through dynamic new display options, fostering a more intuitive and integrated thinking experience.

title: Noeko Self-Hosting and Enterprise Plans
summary: Experience Noeko's full power with new self-hosting capabilities and tailored enterprise plans designed to meet your organization's unique needs.

title: Transform Your Experience with Enhanced and Expanded Themes
summary: We're refreshing existing themes and introducing exciting new options to give you more beautiful ways to personalize your experience.

title: Personalized Time-Based Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more precise and personalized welcome with greetings that accurately match the time of day, enhancing your daily experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Actions
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items with new bulk actions, allowing you to quickly unapply tags, delete items, or view details directly from any tag view.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Capture insights from a broader spectrum of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and plain text, to enrich your personal knowledge platform like never before.
